submit.title: Submit a Pattern
submit.intro: Add a pattern from a link, a saved page or PDF, pasted text, or photos. We'll sort it into materials, abbreviations, and steps for you to review before saving.
submit.genericFetchError: Could not fetch that page. Check the URL and try again.
submit.uploadIntro: Upload a saved HTML page or a PDF - useful if a site blocks automatic fetching, or if the pattern only exists as a PDF (e.g. a paid Etsy/Ravelry download).
submit.uploadUrlHint: A saved web page needs the original page's link, to credit the source and avoid duplicates. For a PDF it's optional.
submit.uploadPdfUrlHint: If this PDF also has a page online, add its link to credit the source and catch duplicates. The author is read from the PDF itself.
submit.guestPromptTail: to actually submit a pattern - uploads are tied to an account so you can edit them later.
submit.alreadyHaveIntro: Already have this pattern saved? Check the
submit.alreadyHaveTail: page first - Yarnboard avoids storing the same source URL twice.
submit.modeGroupLabel: How do you want to add the pattern?
submit.textPlaceholder:
Cozy Beanie
Materials:
- 2 skeins of yarn
Instructions:
1. Cast on 96 stitches.
submit.textHint: Title on the first line. Start sections with "Materials:", "Instructions:" or a part name ending in ":".
submit.photosHint: A printed page, a book, or a handwritten card - in page order, up to {{max}}. The first photo becomes the pattern's picture.
submit.photosTooMany: Only the first {{max}} photos were kept.

review.title: Review before saving
review.saveNotice: This pattern is saved privately to your account - only you (and admins) can see it until you choose to publish it to the community from the pattern's page.
review.noSourceLabel: No original link - this pattern will be saved without one.
review.usePhotoLabel: Use this photo as the pattern's picture

publishConsent.intro: this pattern will become visible to the whole Yarnboard community, along with your username and a link back to the original source. Please only publish patterns you have the right to share, and review the content for accuracy first.
publishConsent.checkboxLabel: I understand this pattern will be published publicly.

reviewForm.photoHint: You can upload a different photo after publishing, from the pattern's Edit page.
reviewForm.materialsHint: One item per line. Add a link with [name](https://...). Headings (#) and notes (>) work the same as in the instructions.
reviewForm.instructionsHint: Start a line with # (or ##, ###...) for a heading, or > for a note - neither gets a checkbox. Steps starting with a row range like "5-10" get a row counter.

patternDetail.unreviewedNotice: Machine-translated, not yet reviewed by a person - stitch terminology may not be fully accurate.

visibility.unpublishConfirm: Make this pattern private again? It will no longer be visible in the community.
visibility.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this pattern? This can't be undone - everyone's saved progress on it will be lost too.
visibility.shareAsEditor: Allow this person to edit the pattern

stitchFiddle.title: Stitch Fiddle Charts
stitchFiddle.intro: Paste a link to one of your public Stitch Fiddle charts. Import turns it into a pattern with a reconstructed chart image and a color list - written instructions aren't generated (that's a Stitch Fiddle premium feature), so add those yourself afterward via the pattern's Edit page if you want them.
